name: Orbit Scheduler
observations: A small library that plans recurring jobs with jitter and back-off.
Adds calendar-aware scheduling (business days, holidays) in 2.4.0.
Exponential back-off is now capped at 30 seconds (2.4.0).
Fixed a jitter bug that could schedule a job in the past (2.4.0).
Version 2.3.1 fixed a memory leak in the job registry.
